source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: We are about to add a connect timeout. Rename the ambiguous config field `timeoutMs` to `requestTimeoutMs` first so the two cannot be confused.
constraints: Environment variable names must not change.
input.context: Sync client (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by `tsc --noEmit`). Config is loaded once in src/config.js and passed around.

ground_truth.material_issue: src/worker.js still reads config.timeoutMs, which is now undefined: the deadline becomes NaN and jobs never expire. tsc flags the missing property; tests do not cover worker.js.
required_observations: Jobs never expire (NaN deadline) / typecheck fails
